Why does Lord Jagannath have no hands, and big round eyes? As the story goes, King Indradyumna of Puri wanted a statue of the Lord. An old carpenter appeared and said, I will carve it. But lock me in for twenty-one days. Nobody opens the door.
Days passed. The sound of the chisel echoed. Then, on day fifteen, silence. The queen got worried. What if the old man has died? So she opened the door.

The carpenter had vanished. The statues were unfinished. No hands. No feet. Just big round eyes. Wait, did the king carve them again? He wanted to. But that night, the Lord came in his dream and said, keep me like this.
With no hands, I still hold you. With these big eyes, I see everyone. That's why, even today, Jagannath looks like that. Comment Jai Jagannath.
